description: The plot illustrates how two accuracy measures (“Initial Accuracy” and “Final Accuracy”) vary across different values of “o_pop frequency.” The x-axis is labeled “o_pop frequency (x10^4)” on a linear scale, with tick marks at 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 19 (range 1–19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with regularly spaced ticks at 0.2 intervals. The “Initial Accuracy” series is shown as a green solid line with square markers and vertical error bars; it starts near 0.34 at x=1, rises to about 0.49 at x=5, drops to around 0.30 at x=7, increases to about 0.52 at x=13, then declines to roughly 0.36 at x=17 and ends near 0.40 at x=19. The “Final Accuracy” series is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers and vertical error bars; it begins around 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to roughly 0.72 at x=7, peaks near 0.92 at x=9, falls to about 0.69–0.70 at x=11–13, rises again to around 0.90 at x=15, dips to about 0.82 at x=17, and ends near 0.90 at x=19.
